scientific_integrity: The exact Gibbs formula and prior spectral crossing are background. Global asymptotic optimization and boundary-layer coefficient are proved here and independently sampled numerically; finite numerics are not proof. scientific_limitations: Exact constrained two-spin longitudinal-field canonical model; low-temperature asymptotics at fixed J,R only. No general XY, XYZ, many-body, finite-time or arbitrary-control theorem; full earliest 2003 primary article not inspected.
title: Logarithmic low-temperature allocation of a fixed magnetic-field budget in an XX dimer
